note: The public version ladder. `phase` must equal the private roadmap's ladder, row for row (scripts/check-ladder.mjs); `summary` is written for the site and never copied from a private document. States: done, planned, goal, later.

rungs.summary: The foundation: the plugin loads as CLAP, VST3 and AU and as a standalone app, passes your audio through untouched, asks you to accept its licence, and every quality gate runs.

rungs.phase: Phase 1 — The copier and the first copy
rungs.summary: The copier and the first copy: the machine in the window, the green START, and a MIDI file copied into audio you drag straight into your DAW.

rungs.phase: Phase 2 — Audio → MIDI: the magic moment
rungs.summary: Audio to MIDI: drop a loop on the glass, press START, and drag out its drums, bass, melody and chords as MIDI.

rungs.phase: Phase 3 — The File Browser & Preview Player
rungs.summary: The file browser and preview player: find a sample or a MIDI clip, hear it, see it, and drag it onto the glass. Everything essential is here.
The touch screen: copy settings, instruments for your copies, file formats, and the history of every copy you have made.
The Studio: open any copy in a piano roll, change its notes, hear it through any instrument, and print your edit as a new copy.

rungs.phase: Phase 4.7 — The mixer and your own instruments
rungs.summary: The mixer and your own instruments: realistic knobs to shape every part, your own drum kits and samples, favourites, and one instrument library shared by every Freally app.
Skins and light mode: five skins, each a raised chassis rendered in Blender and the same across every Freally app, in light and dark, beside a new light mode.
In every DAW: saved with your project, several copies at once, scanning straight from a track, and checked DAW by DAW.

rungs.phase: Phase 6 — Standalone, macOS, Linux & the promo
rungs.summary: The standalone app at full strength, macOS and Linux, and the video of the copier at work.
Accuracy, realism and speed: better transcriptions, a more convincing machine, and every performance budget enforced.
Hardened: installers for three systems, the optional update check, and the full illustrated manual. Still no downloads on this site.
The release candidate: every file reviewed and every host tested by hand.
The release — and the first downloads this site has ever offered.
The document feeder: copy a whole folder in one go.
Score copies: MusicXML and a staff-notation print.
Bridges to the other Freally products.
Pro Tools as a plugin (AAX), if Avid's terms allow it for a free product.
Groove copies, and rough, AI-free stem copies.
